newsitem.title: USA: Bangor Hydro may have to cut dividend.
newsitem.headline: Bangor Hydro may have to cut dividend.

text.p: Bangor Hydro-Electric Co said Thursday its 1997 financial results may be adversely affected by, and it may have to cut its dividend because of, costs incurred at its Maine Yankee nuclear power plant, which the company shuttered in early December for repairs and inspections.
Bangor said the plant incurs about $1 million in costs per month that it is not operating, and it may also have to raise rates to offset the costs.
The company did not give specific details. Officials from the company were not immediately available.
The company said Thursday it earned $0.24 per share in its fourth quarter of fiscal 1996, compared with $0.20 per share a year earlier.
The company now pays a regular quarterly dividend of $0.18 per share.
